concepts.title: Moonlit beach
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide gameplay art concept for Last Chance Resort, a physics-based volleyball game in a malfunctioning automated luxury resort.
Reference image: use ONLY for polished 3D rendering style, adult player identities, side-view gameplay framing and court proportions. The scene location is specified below; replace the environment when requested.
Primary request: a single beautiful, coherent 16:10 landscape gameplay scene showing two human volleyball players, clearly visible gift-delivery quadcopter drones, and conspicuous robot hazards disrupting their rally.
Camera: orthographic straight side-view, not tilted or isometric. The playable floor is a continuous straight horizontal line at 84% of image height over a dark foreground plinth. Rigid slim side barriers frame the extreme edges; cyan left service button and coral right service button. A volleyball net viewed EXACTLY EDGE-ON is represented by a single slim central vertical pole rising from the floor to 58% of image height, not a wide net stretched across the picture.
Players: dark-haired adult man in teal athletic shorts on the left, adult woman with ponytail in coral sportswear on the right, believable anatomy and expressive articulated physics poses. Standing height about 23% of frame. Both fully readable. One yellow-blue-white volleyball clearly visible above the court.
Drones: unmistakable real QUADCOPTERS, each with a central friendly service body, FOUR separated propeller arms with spinning rotor discs, small status lights. Each drone carries one gift box with ribbon BELOW its body using a claw or sling, visually separate from the fuselage. Ivory bodies with teal or orange accents. Rotor-span about half a player's height. No bees, insects or winged mascots.
Hazards: compact but prominent malfunctioning hospitality robots on the same playable floor, about half to two-thirds the player height. Distinct readable silhouettes and functioning mechanisms, cute practical resort equipment rather than enemies with weapons. Separate players, robots and drone cargo spatially; don't overlap important silhouettes. Maintain an unobstructed ball path.
Style: polished modern stylized 3D game render, realistic adult anatomy, believable glossy polymer and brushed metal, crisp readable foreground objects, much quieter broad-shape background, restrained warm/cool lighting. Comedic sports action rather than combat.
No text, HUD, labels, watermark, collage, panels, arrows, crowd, extra humans, weapons, violence, gore, explosions, huge glowing effects, dense particle fog or decorative clutter.

Location: the approved moonlit tropical BEACH. Midnight navy sky, silver-blue ocean, sparse palms at far edges, a small hotel with warm window lights on the right cliff, cool sand court. Preserve the reference's relaxed night mood and uncluttered sky.
Composition: two gift drones hover at x23% y42% and x76% y37%, carrying coral and teal wrapped presents. Man at x35% leaps to hit the ball at x43% y51%; woman at x70% braces to receive.
Ground hazards: at x14% a rounded ivory luggage-assistant robot with a VERY LARGE visible red horseshoe MAGNET on a jointed arm aimed at the leaping man, with just a few thin curved attraction traces; at x86% an ivory fitness-coach robot on a compact wheeled base with two oversized coral BOXING GLOVES on extending articulated arms, one extending toward the woman. Both robots visually clear in warm foreground light. This is a gameplay screenshot-like concept of an absurd automated beach service interrupting volleyball.
